extends Node
var p
var last_probe_idle := -1
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	p.write_state("ready", true)
	_probe("ready")
	call_deferred("_deferred")
func _probe(label: String) -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	last_probe_idle = Engine.get_process_frames()
	print("VIENTO_EXECUTION_FRAME_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify({"label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}, "revision": host.state_revision}))
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
var process_steps := 0
var physics_steps := 0
var deferred_done := false
func _deferred() -> void:
	p.write_state("deferred", true)
	_probe("deferred")
	deferred_done = true
func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	process_steps += 1
	if process_steps <= 3:
		p.write_state("process", process_steps)
		_probe("process-" + str(process_steps))
	if process_steps >= 8 and physics_steps >= 3 and deferred_done and Engine.get_process_frames() > last_probe_idle + 3:
		set_process(false)
		call_deferred("_finish")
func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	physics_steps += 1
	p.write_state("physics", physics_steps)
	_probe("physics-" + str(physics_steps))
	if physics_steps == 3:
		set_physics_process(false)
